products.title: GRATEFUL DEAD LONG VACATION PONCHO
products.body_text:
The Long Vacation Pancho builds the collection's boldest pattern into an oversized hooded layer. A full jacquard graphic, large front pocket, and snap-adjustable sides create an easy drape with enough structure to make the artwork the focus.
Fabrication: 80% cotton 20% wool jacquard knit
Oversized hooded poncho construction

products.body_text:

Five-panel cap silhouette
Adjustable rear snapback closure
One size fits most

products.body_text:

Lining: 100% quilted nylon
Relaxed fit
Classic snap-front varsity jacket construction
Patterned jacquard rib at collar, cuffs, and waistband
Quilted interior lining
Branded metal snap closure at center front
